title: Malaysian Pilot Smuggled 55 Pounds of Ecstasy Into Indonesia, Officials Say
summary_full: The pilot, identified only by his initials, also tested positive for ecstasy and cocaine when he was arrested last week at the Jakarta airport, the Indonesian police said.
